en.t: Austrasian king Carloman I dies, leaving his brother Charlemagne as sole king of the Frankish Kingdom
en.s: Carloman I (28 June 751 – 4 December 771), German Karlmann, Karlomann, was king of the Franks from 768 until his death in 771. He was the second surviving son of Pepin the Short and Bertrada of Laon and was a younger brother of Charlemagne. His death allowed Charlemagne to take all of Francia.

zh.t: 加洛林王朝国王卡洛曼一世逝世，查理曼成为法兰克王国唯一国王
zh.s: 卡洛曼一世（751年6月28日—771年12月4日；德语：Karlmann、Karlomann）是法兰克人的国王，768年至771年在位。他是丕平三世和拉昂的贝特拉达次子，也是查理曼的弟弟。他去世后，查理曼得以统治整个法兰克王国。

en.t: The lay papal protonotary is elected pope and takes the name Leo VIII, being consecrated on 6 December after ordination
en.s: In the Catholic Church, protonotary apostolic (PA; Latin: protonotarius apostolicus) is the title for a member of the highest non-episcopal college of prelates in the Roman Curia or, outside Rome, an honorary prelate on whom the pope has conferred this title and its special privileges. An example is Prince Georg of Bavaria (1880–1943), who became in 1926 protonotary by papal decree.

zh.t: 一名平信徒宗座首席书记官当选教宗，取名利奥八世；他先接受祝圣，后于12月6日晋牧
zh.s: 在天主教会中，宗座首席书记官（PA；拉丁语：protonotarius apostolicus）是罗马教廷内最高级别的非主教级高级教士团成员的职衔。在罗马以外，教宗也会授予部分荣誉教士这一职衔及其特殊权利。例如，巴伐利亚的格奥尔格王子（1880—1943）于1926年经教宗敕令获授该职衔。

en.t: An army led by Baldwin I of Jerusalem and Sigurd the Crusader of Norway captures Sidon at the end of the First Crusade
en.s: Sigurd the Crusader (Old Norse: Sigurðr Jórsalafari; Norwegian: Sigurd Jorsalfare; 1089 – 26 March 1130), also known as Sigurd Magnusson and Sigurd I, was King of Norway from 1103 to 1130. His rule, together with his half-brothers King Øystein (until Øystein died in 1123) and King Olaf, has been regarded by historians as a golden age for the medieval Kingdom of Norway.

zh.t: 耶路撒冷国王鲍德温一世与挪威十字军国王西居尔率军在第一次十字军东征末期攻占西顿
zh.s: 十字军国王西居尔（古诺尔斯语：Sigurðr Jórsalafari；挪威语：Sigurd Jorsalfare；1089年—1130年3月26日），又称西居尔·马格努松和西居尔一世，1103年至1130年担任挪威国王。他与同父异母兄弟奥斯特因国王（在1123年去世前）和奥拉夫国王共同统治的时期，被历史学家视为中世纪挪威王国的黄金时代。

en.s: The Treaty of Paris, also known as the Treaty of Abbeville, was signed on December 4, 1259, by King Louis IX of France and King Henry III of England. It marked a turning point in European politics, leading to new political dynamics, cultural exchanges, and social changes.

zh.s: 1259年12月4日，法国国王路易九世和英格兰国王亨利三世签署巴黎条约，也称阿布维尔条约。该条约成为欧洲政治的转折点，带来了新的政治格局、文化交流和社会变化。

en.s: The Battle of Pontvallain was an important battle in the Hundred Years' War between France and England. It was fought on the 4 December 1370 in the Sarthe region between English forces that had broken away from the army commanded by the English knight Sir Robert Knolles and a French army under the newly appointed Constable of France, Bertrand du Guesclin. The battle was in fact two separate engagements, one at Pontvallain and a smaller one at the nearby town of Vaas; they are sometimes named as separate battles.

zh.s: 蓬特瓦兰战役是英法百年战争中的一场重要战斗，于1370年12月4日在法国萨尔特地区爆发。交战双方是脱离英国骑士罗伯特·诺尔斯所率军队的英军，以及新任法国王室统帅贝特朗·杜·盖克兰率领的法军。这场战斗实际上由两场交战组成，一场在蓬特瓦兰，另一场规模较小，在附近的瓦镇；有时两场会被分别称为不同战役。

en.t: 50 Christians are executed in Edo, Japan, during the Great Martyrdom of Edo
en.s: The Great Martyrdom of Edo was the execution of 50 foreign and domestic Catholics (kirishitans), who were burned alive for their Christianity in Edo (modern-day Tokyo), Japan, on 4 December 1623. The mass execution was part of the persecution of Christians in Japan by Tokugawa Iemitsu, the third shogun of the Tokugawa shogunate. Among the executed was Jerome de Angelis (1567–1623), an Italian Jesuit missionary to Japan.

zh.t: 江户大殉教事件中，50名基督徒在日本被处决
zh.s: 1623年12月4日，日本江户（今东京）处决了50名外国和日本本地天主教徒（基督徒），他们因信仰而被活活烧死。这场大规模处决是德川幕府第三代将军德川家光迫害日本基督徒的一部分。遇害者包括意大利耶稣会传教士杰罗姆·德安吉利斯（1567—1623）。

en.s: The Battle of Lund, part of the Scanian War, was fought on December 4, 1676, in an area north of the city of Lund in Scania in southern Sweden, between the invading Danish army and the army of Charles XI of Sweden. The Danish had an army of about 13,000 under the personal command of 31-year-old King Christian V of Denmark, aided by General Carl von Arensdorff. The Swedish army, which numbered about 8,000, was commanded by Field Marshal Simon Grundel-Helmfelt and the 21-year-old Swedish king Charles XI. It is one of the bloodiest battles in percent of casualties on both sides ever fought on European soil.

zh.s: 隆德战役是斯堪尼亚战争的一部分，于1676年12月4日在瑞典南部斯堪尼亚、隆德市以北地区爆发。交战双方是入侵的丹麦军队和瑞典国王卡尔十一世的军队。丹麦军约有13,000人，由31岁的国王克里斯蒂安五世亲自统率，卡尔·冯·阿伦斯多夫将军协助指挥。瑞典军约有8,000人，由陆军元帅西蒙·格伦德尔-赫尔姆费尔特和21岁的国王卡尔十一世指挥。这是欧洲土地上双方伤亡比例最高的战役之一。

en.s: The siege of Grand Pré happened during Father Le Loutre's War and was fought between the British and the Wabanaki Confederacy and Acadian militia. The siege happened at Fort Vieux Logis, Grand-Pré (present-day Hortonville, Nova Scotia). The native and Acadia militia laid siege to Fort Vieux Logis for a week in November 1749. One historian states that the intent of the siege was to help facilitate the Acadian Exodus from the region.

zh.s: 大普雷围城战发生在勒卢特神父战争期间，交战双方为英国军队、瓦巴纳基联盟和阿卡迪亚民兵。战斗发生在大普雷的维厄洛吉斯堡（今新斯科舍省霍顿维尔）。1749年11月，原住民和阿卡迪亚民兵围攻该堡一周。有历史学家认为，这次围城意在推动阿卡迪亚人离开当地。

en.s: The Battle of Meissen (4 December 1759) was an Austrian victory over a larger Prussian army during the Seven Years' War. Despite being outnumbered by a 26,000 strongPrussian army, the 21,000 Austrians secured an important victory, which effectively kept their ally Saxony in the war.

zh.s: 迈森战役于1759年12月4日爆发，是七年战争期间奥地利军队对规模更大的普鲁士军队取得的一场胜利。尽管普军有26,000人，奥军仅有21,000人，奥地利仍赢得重要胜利，实际上使其盟友萨克森得以继续参战。

en.t: The first edition of The Observer, the world's first Sunday newspaper, is published
en.s: The Observer is a British newspaper published on Sundays. First published in 1791, it is the world's oldest Sunday newspaper. In 1993 it was acquired by Guardian Media Group Limited, and operated as a sister paper to The Guardian and The Guardian Weekly. In December 2024, Tortoise Media acquired the paper from the Scott Trust Limited, and took ownership of The Observer on 22 April 2025.

zh.s: 《观察家报》是一份英国周日报纸，创刊于1791年，是世界上历史最悠久的周日报纸。1993年，该报被卫报集团有限公司收购，并作为《卫报》和《卫报周刊》的姊妹报纸运营。2024年12月，海龟媒体从斯科特信托手中收购该报，并于2025年4月22日正式接管。

en.s: At the Capitulation of Madrid, on 4 December 1808, that city's military commander Tomás de Morla and the civil governor Fernando de la Vera, in representation of the Junta of Defence (Junta Militar y Política de Madrid), capitulated to the Prince de Neuchâtel, Marshal Louis-Alexandre Berthier, in representation of Napoleon, who had himself arrived two days previously at the head of over 40,000 troops, at Chamartin, then a small village just outside the city, to the north, on 2 December, the anniversary of his important victory at Austerlitz.

zh.s: 1808年12月4日，马德里的军事指挥官托马斯·德·莫拉和民政总督费尔南多·德·拉·维拉代表马德里防卫委员会（Junta Militar y Política de Madrid），向代表拿破仑的讷沙泰尔亲王、元帅路易-亚历山大·贝尔蒂埃投降。两天前，拿破仑率领超过40,000名军队抵达当时位于城北郊外的小村庄查马丁；那天也是他在奥斯特里茨取得重要胜利的周年纪念日。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1816 was the eighth quadrennial presidential election. It was held from Friday, November 1 to Wednesday, December 4, 1816. It came at the end of the two-term presidency of Democratic-Republican James Madison. With the Federalist Party on the verge of collapse, Madison's Secretary of State, James Monroe, had an overwhelming advantage against very weak opposition. Monroe won the electoral college by the wide margin of 183 to 34. The previous four years of American politics were dominated by the effects of the War of 1812.
en.n: This entry records the Electoral College vote on the first Wednesday of December (4 December 1816), following the selection of electors.

zh.s: 1816年美国总统选举是美国第八次每四年举行一次的总统选举，投票从1816年11月1日（星期五）持续到12月4日（星期三）。选举时，民主共和党人詹姆斯·麦迪逊的两个总统任期即将结束。联邦党濒临瓦解，麦迪逊的国务卿詹姆斯·门罗面对实力很弱的对手，优势明显。门罗以183票对34票的巨大优势赢得选举人团投票。此前四年，美国政治主要受1812年战争的影响。
zh.n: 此条记录采用选举人于1816年12月4日投票的日期；各州此前已选出选举人。

en.t: Patriot raiders briefly capture Windsor before local militia drives them out
en.s: Early on December 4, 1838, armed American and Canadian supporters of William Lyon Mackenzie crossed the Detroit River and occupied Windsor in Upper Canada. They burned a militia barracks, but local militiamen commanded by Colonel John Prince soon drove them out. The battle took place in what is now Ontario, Canada.
en.n: The raid and militia response occurred on December 4, 1838, in Windsor, Upper Canada.

zh.t: 爱国者武装短暂占领温莎，随后被当地民兵击退
zh.s: 1838年12月4日清晨，支持威廉·莱昂·麦肯齐的美国人与加拿大人组成的武装队伍渡过底特律河，占领了当时属上加拿大的温莎。他们烧毁一处民兵营房，但很快被约翰·普林斯上校率领的当地民兵击退。战斗地点位于今天加拿大的安大略省。
zh.n: 渡河袭击、短暂占领及民兵反击均发生于1838年12月4日。

en.s: The siege of Laghouat was an episode of the French pacification of Algeria. General Aimable Pélissier commanding an army of 6,000, besieged the city of Laghouat from 21 November until 4 December 1852, when the city capitulated. The brutal treatment of the inhabitants was part of the scorched earth tactic of the French army and one of the first instances of recorded use of chemical weapon on civilians.

zh.s: 拉古瓦特围城战是法国对阿尔及利亚实施“平定”行动期间的一次战役。阿迈布尔·佩利西耶将军率领6000人从1852年11月21日起围攻该城，直至12月4日城池投降。法国军队残酷对待当地居民，采用焦土战术；这是有记录以来最早对平民使用化学武器的案例之一。

en.s: The Battle of the Mimbres River was a surprise attack launched by a troop of American militia against an encampment of Chiricahua Apaches along the western shore of the Mimbres River. On December 4, 1860, a force of thirty armed miners led by James Henry Tevis attacked at sunrise, claiming it was retaliation for stolen livestock. The surprised Apaches, led by Mangas Coloradas, were quickly defeated in a short close quarters action.

zh.s: 明布雷斯河战役是美国民兵对希里卡瓦阿帕奇人营地发动的一次突袭，营地位于明布雷斯河西岸。1860年12月4日，詹姆斯·亨利·特维斯率领30名携枪矿工在日出时袭击营地，声称此举是为报复牲畜被盗。曼加斯·科罗拉达斯率领的阿帕奇人猝不及防，在短暂的近距离交战中很快被击败。

en.s: The Bog Wallow Ambush was a small unit action during the American Civil War that took place between Confederate forces under Captain J. Fred. Waring and Union forces under Colonel George W. Taylor on December 4, 1861, in Fairfax County, Virginia, as part of Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan's operations in northern Virginia. The Union force set up an ambush for the Confederate force on the Braddock Road.

zh.s: 沼泽洼地伏击战是美国南北战争期间的一次小规模部队行动，于1861年12月4日在弗吉尼亚州费尔法克斯县发生，是乔治·B.麦克莱伦少将北弗吉尼亚行动的一部分。交战双方是J.弗雷德·沃林上尉指挥的南方邦联军和乔治·W.泰勒上校指挥的联邦军。联邦军在布拉多克路上设伏，袭击南方邦联部队。

en.s: The siege of Knoxville (November 17 – December 4, 1863) saw Lieutenant General James Longstreet's Confederate forces besiege the Union garrison of Knoxville, Tennessee, led by Major General Ambrose Burnside, in the American Civil War. When Major General William T. Sherman approached Knoxville with an overwhelming Union force, Longstreet ended the siege on December 4 and withdrew northeast. The siege was part of the Knoxville campaign of the Civil War.
en.n: American Civil War: Confederate General James Longstreet lifts his unsuccessful siege of Knoxville, Tennessee after failing to capture the city.

en.s: The Battle of La Canela (Spanish: Batalla de la Canela) was one of the last battles of the Dominican Restoration War. It took place on December 4, 1864, near La Canela (now Galván). A force of 600 Dominican troops under General José María Cabral, positioned on higher ground, engaged a Spanish convoy of 80 Spaniards and 31 local troops in open-field combat.

zh.s: 拉卡内拉战役（西班牙语：Batalla de la Canela）是多米尼加复国战争的最后几场战斗之一，于1864年12月4日在拉卡内拉（今加尔万）附近爆发。何塞·玛丽亚·卡布拉尔将军率领600名多米尼加士兵占据高地，与一支西班牙车队交战；车队有80名西班牙士兵和31名当地士兵，双方在开阔地交战。

en.s: The Battle of Waynesboro was an American Civil War battle fought on December 4, 1864, in eastern Georgia, towards the end of Sherman's March to the Sea. Union cavalry forces under Brig. Gen. Judson Kilpatrick defeated Confederate cavalry led by Maj. Gen. Joseph Wheeler, opening the way for William T. Sherman's armies to approach their objective, Savannah. As Sherman's infantry marched southeast through Georgia, his cavalry under Judson Kilpatrick rode northeastward.

zh.t: 韦恩斯伯勒战役（佐治亚州）
zh.s: 韦恩斯伯勒战役是美国南北战争期间的一场战斗，于1864年12月4日在佐治亚州东部爆发，发生在谢尔曼向海进军接近尾声时。贾德森·基尔帕特里克准将率领的联邦骑兵击败了约瑟夫·惠勒少将率领的南方邦联骑兵，为威廉·T.谢尔曼的部队向萨凡纳推进扫清了道路。谢尔曼的步兵向东南穿过佐治亚州时，基尔帕特里克的骑兵则向东北行动。

en.s: The Battle of Hakodate (函館戦争 Hakodate Sensō) was fought in Japan from December 4, 1868 to June 27, 1869, between the remnants of the Tokugawa shogunate army, consolidated into the armed forces of the rebel Ezo Republic, and the armies of the newly formed Imperial government (composed mainly of forces of the Chōshū and the Satsuma domains). It was the last stage of the Boshin War, and occurred around Hakodate in the northern Japanese island of Hokkaidō. In Japanese, it is also known as the Battle of the Goryokaku (五稜郭の戦い Goryokaku no tatakai) According to the Japanese calendar, the Battle of Hakodate was fought from Meiji-1 year (gannen), 10-month, 21-day until Meiji-2 year, 5-month 18-day.

zh.s: 函馆战役（日语：函館戦争，Hakodate Sensō）于1868年12月4日至1869年6月27日在日本爆发。交战双方是德川幕府军残部组成的虾夷共和国武装力量，以及新成立的日本帝国政府军，后者主要由长州和萨摩藩军队组成。这是戊辰战争的最后阶段，战事发生在日本北部北海道的函馆一带。该战也称五棱郭之战（日语：五稜郭の戦い，Goryokaku no tatakai）。按日本历法，战事从明治元年十月二十一日持续至明治二年五月十八日。

en.s: The Battle of Buchy was fought during the Franco-Prussian War, on 4 December 1870, at Buchy, Seine-Maritime, France. During the battle, the VIII Corps of the Prussian Army, under the command of General of the Infantry August Karl von Goeben, suddenly attacked and defeated a French force under the command of General de Brigade Guillaume Briand. The French suffered heavy losses.

zh.s: 比希战役于1870年12月4日在法国滨海塞纳省比希爆发，是普法战争中的一场战斗。奥古斯特·卡尔·冯·戈本将军指挥的普鲁士军队第八军突然袭击并击败了纪尧姆·布里昂准将率领的法军。法军损失惨重。

en.s: The Second Battle of Orléans of Battle of Vaumainbert was fought during the Franco-Prussian War of 1870. It took place on December 3 and 4, 1870 and was part of the Loire Campaign. The Germans recaptured Orléans, which had been retaken by the French on November 11, 1870 after the Battle of Coulmiers, and divided the French Army of the Loire in two.

en.t: Mary Celeste (, often erroneously referred to as Marie Celeste) was a Canadian-built, American-registered, merchant brigantine that was discovered adrift and deserted in the Atlantic Ocean off the Azores on December 4, 1872
en.s: Mary Celeste (, often erroneously referred to as Marie Celeste) was a Canadian-built, American-registered, merchant brigantine that was discovered adrift and deserted in the Atlantic Ocean off the Azores on December 4, 1872. The Canadian brigantine Dei Gratia found the Mary Celeste in a dishevelled but seaworthy condition under partial sail and with the lifeboat missing. The last entry in the log was dated 10 days earlier.

zh.s: “玛丽·塞莱斯特”号是一艘加拿大建造、美国注册的商用双桅帆船。1872年12月4日，它在亚速尔群岛附近的大西洋被发现失去控制、船上无人。“德伊·格拉西亚”号加拿大双桅帆船发现它时，船体凌乱但仍可航行，帆只部分升起，救生艇已不见踪影。航海日志最后一条记录写于10天前。

en.s: The Battle of Novšiće (Serbian: Boj na Novšiću/Бој на Новшићу; Bitka na Novšićima/Битка на Новшићима, Albanian: Beteja e Nokshiqit)) was a battle for control over Plav and Gusinje fought on 4 December 1879 between the forces of Principality of Montenegro led by Marko Miljanov and local pro-Ottoman forces which included irregulars of the League of Prizren, both commanded by Ali Bey, the kaymekam of Gusinje. The League of Prizren consisted of the local Albanians and Slavic Muslims from Plav and Gusinje in Scutari Vilayet and irregulars from Kosovo Vilayet. This battle followed the Montenegrin–Ottoman War (1876–78).

zh.s: 诺夫希奇战役（塞尔维亚语：Boj na Novšiću／Бој на Новшићу；Bitka na Novšićima／Битка на Новшићима；阿尔巴尼亚语：Beteja e Nokshiqit）于1879年12月4日爆发，交战双方是黑山公国军队与当地亲奥斯曼势力，争夺普拉夫和古西涅的控制权。黑山军由马尔科·米利亚诺夫率领；当地势力包括普里兹伦联盟的非正规部队，由古西涅的凯马克姆阿里贝伊统一指挥。普里兹伦联盟由斯库台省普拉夫和古西涅的阿尔巴尼亚人、斯拉夫穆斯林，以及科索沃省的非正规部队组成。这场战斗发生在1876—1878年黑山—奥斯曼战争之后。

en.t: The first edition of the Los Angeles Times is published
en.s: The Los Angeles Times is an American daily newspaper that began publishing in Los Angeles, California, in 1881. Based in the Greater Los Angeles city of El Segundo, it is the sixth-largest newspaper in the U.S. As of 2025, it had approximately 63,000 print subscribers and 243,000 digital subscribers. The paper has won over 52 Pulitzer Prizes since 1942.

zh.s: 《洛杉矶时报》是美国日报，1881年开始在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶发行。报社总部位于大洛杉矶地区的埃尔塞贡多，是美国发行量第六大的报纸。2025年，该报纸质版订户约6.3万人，数字版订户约24.3万人。自1942年以来，该报获得了52项以上普利策奖。

en.s: The Gapsin Coup (Korean:갑신정변, 甲申政變), also known as the Gapsin Revolution (갑신혁명, 甲申革命) and Kapsin Incident, was a failed three-day coup d'état which started on 4 December 1884 in the late Joseon Dynasty of Korea. The pro-Japanese leaders of the coup were suppressed by a Chinese garrison in Korea, which led to Chinese domination of Korea from 1885-1894. The Korean name for the events takes from the year designator in the traditional sexagenary cycle system of dating, "gapsin" here referring to the year 1884.

zh.s: 甲申政变（韩语：갑신정변，甲申政變）也称甲申革命、甲申事变，是朝鲜王朝末期一场为期三天的失败政变，于1884年12月4日开始。亲日派政变领导人被驻朝清军镇压，导致中国从1885年至1894年主导朝鲜。事件名称中的“甲申”来自传统干支纪年法，指1884年。

en.s: The Shangani Patrol (or Wilson's Patrol) was a 37-soldier unit of the British South Africa Company that in 1893 was ambushed and annihilated by over 3,000 Matabele warriors in pre-Southern Rhodesia (now Zimbabwe), during the First Matabele War. Headed by Major Allan Wilson, the patrol was attacked just north of the Shangani River in Matabeleland, Rhodesia.

en.t: Alpha Phi Alpha, the first intercollegiate Greek lettered fraternity for African-Americans, was founded at Cornell University in Ithaca, New York
en.s: Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. (ΑΦΑ) is the oldest intercollegiate historically African American fraternity. It was initially a literary and social studies club organized in the 1905–1906 school year at Cornell University but later evolved into a fraternity with a founding date of December 4, 1906. zh.s: 艾因扎拉战役于1911年12月爆发，是意土战争期间意大利王国与奥斯曼帝国军队为争夺艾因扎拉绿洲控制权而进行的战斗。该绿洲位于今利比亚的黎波里附近，当时奥斯曼人在那里建有一处设防基地。

en.t: The Finnish Senate submits to the Parliament of Finland a proposal for the form of government of the Republic of Finland and issues a communication to Parliament declaring the independence of Finland
en.s: The Senate of Finland (Swedish: Senaten för Finland; Finnish: Suomen senaatti) combined the functions of cabinet and supreme court in the Grand Duchy of Finland and, from 1917, in independent Finland. It was established in 1809 as the Governing Council of the Grand Duchy of Finland (Regeringskonseljen för Storfurstendömet Finland), renamed the Imperial Senate of Finland (Kejserliga senaten för Finland) in 1816, and dissolved in 1918.

zh.t: 芬兰参议院向芬兰议会提交共和国政体方案，并发表声明宣布芬兰独立
zh.s: 芬兰参议院（瑞典语：Senaten för Finland；芬兰语：Suomen senaatti）在芬兰大公国时期兼具内阁和最高法院职能，1917年芬兰独立后也继续履行这两项职能。该机构于1809年以芬兰大公国执政委员会之名设立，1816年更名为芬兰帝国参议院，1918年解散。

en.t: Cosmo Gordon Lang was enthroned as the Archbishop of Canterbury, the first bachelor to be appointed in 150 years
en.s: William Cosmo Gordon Lang, 1st Baron Lang of Lambeth, (31 October 1864 – 5 December 1945) was a Scottish Anglican clergyman who served as Archbishop of York (1908–1928) and Archbishop of Canterbury (1928–1942). His elevation to Archbishop of York, within 18 years of his ordination, was the most rapid in modern Church of England history.

zh.t: 科斯莫·戈登·朗就任坎特伯雷大主教，是150年来首位获任的未婚者
zh.s: 威廉·科斯莫·戈登·朗（1864年10月31日—1945年12月5日）是苏格兰圣公会神职人员，曾任约克大主教（1908—1928）和坎特伯雷大主教（1928—1942）。他受按立后不到18年便升任约克大主教，这是近代英格兰教会史上晋升速度最快的案例。

en.s: The 1932 Copa de Competencia Final was the final that decide the winner of the 1st edition of Copa de Competencia, an Argentine domestic cup organised by dissident body Liga Argentina de Football, the first professional league of Argentina. zh.s: 1932年阿根廷足球竞赛杯决赛决出了首届阿根廷足球竞赛杯冠军。该杯赛由阿根廷独立足球联合会——阿根廷首个职业足球联赛组织——主办。决赛于1932年12月4日在圣洛伦索体育场举行，河床以3比1击败拉普拉塔大学生队，首次赢得该项赛事冠军。

en.s: On December 4, 1938, a supplementary vote for 41 Reichstag seats was held in the Sudetenland, which Nazi Germany had recently annexed. The ballot combined a Nazi candidate list with a declaration of support for Hitler. It was separate from the April 10 vote held in Germany and Austria.

en.s: Carlson's patrol, also known as The Long Patrol or Carlson's long patrol, was an operation by the 2nd Marine Raider Battalion under the command of Evans Carlson during the Guadalcanal campaign against the Imperial Japanese Army from 6 November to 4 December 1942. In the operation, the 2nd Raiders attacked forces under the command of Toshinari Shōji, which were escaping from an attempted encirclement in the Koli Point area on Guadalcanal and attempting to rejoin other Japanese army units on the opposite side of the U.S.

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, on December 4, 1950. en.t: U.S. Navy aviator Jesse L. Brown dies near the Chosin Reservoir
en.s: On December 4, 1950, Ensign Jesse L. Brown's fighter was hit while he flew a support mission near the Chosin Reservoir in North Korea. He made a forced landing but was trapped in the damaged aircraft. His wingman Thomas J. Hudner deliberately crash-landed nearby and tried to free him, but Brown died before rescue was possible. Brown was the U.S. Navy's first Black aviator to complete its flight-training program.
en.n: Brown was shot down and died during the battle on December 4; the battle itself lasted across multiple days.

zh.t: 美国海军飞行员杰西·L·布朗在长津湖附近阵亡
zh.s: 1950年12月4日，美国海军少尉杰西·L·布朗在朝鲜长津湖附近执行支援任务时，战机遭击中。他迫降后被困在受损的飞机里。僚机飞行员托马斯·J·哈德纳冒险在附近迫降，试图救出他，但布朗最终未能获救。布朗是首位完成美国海军飞行训练的黑人飞行员。
zh.n: 布朗于12月4日在长津湖战役期间遭击落并死亡；战役持续了多日。

en.s: The Aragarças Revolt, known locally as Revoltoso do Veloso, was an attempted military coup against Brazilian president Juscelino Kubitschek from 2 to 4 December 1959. Mainly carried out by Air Force and Army officers linked to a previous revolt against the government, the Jacareacanga Revolt, the attempt carried out the first plane hijacking in the history of Brazil, but was quickly suppressed.

en.s: Kaser-e-Hind or Qaser-i-Hind is a citadel in the Indian state of Punjab. The fortress was briefly occupied by Pakistani military and was later returned to India after the end of 1971 India-Pakistan War. 41 Baloch Regiment and 45 Field Regiment Pakistan Artillery were awarded battle honours for their tremendous and bold victory over the citadel.

zh.s: 卡伊泽尔-欣德（也称卡瑟尔-欣德）是一座位于印度旁遮普邦的城堡。城堡曾短暂被巴基斯坦军队占领，1971年印巴战争结束后归还印度。巴基斯坦第41俾路支团和第45野战炮兵团因攻占该城堡的行动而获颁战斗荣誉。

en.s: The Defence of Kamalpur was a battle fought over Kamalpur near the border between India and East Pakistan (now Bangladesh) during the Bangladesh War of Independence. Kamalpur, a hamlet in Jamalpur on the border, was defended by 60-70 regular and irregular Pakistani soldiers under the command of Captain Ahsan Malik. The company-sized Pakistani unit fought against a brigade of Indian soldiers and Mukti Bahini troops as the Indian military made several unsuccessful attempts to capture the Pakistani positions.

zh.s: 卡马尔普尔防御战是孟加拉国独立战争期间的一场战斗，地点在印度与东巴基斯坦（今孟加拉国）边境附近的卡马尔普尔。卡马尔普尔是贾马尔布尔县边境上的小村，由阿赫桑·马利克上尉率领的60至70名巴基斯坦正规军和非正规军防守。该连级规模的巴基斯坦部队与印度军队及自由战士组织的一个旅交战；印度军队曾多次尝试攻占巴军阵地，但均未成功。

en.t: The PNS Ghazi, a Pakistan Navy submarine, sinks during the course of the Indo-Pakistani Naval War of 1971
en.s: PNS/M Ghazi (S–130) (previously USS Diablo (SS-479); reporting name: Ghazi), SJ, was a Tench-class diesel-electric submarine, the first fast-attack submarine in the Pakistan Navy. She was leased from the United States Navy in 1963. She served in the United States Navy from 1945 to 1963 and was loaned to Pakistan under the Security Assistance Program (SAP) on a four-year lease after the Ayub administration successfully negotiated with the Kennedy administration for its procurement.

zh.t: 巴基斯坦海军潜艇“加齐”号在1971年印巴海战期间沉没
zh.s: 巴基斯坦海军“加齐”号潜艇（S–130；此前为美国海军“迪亚布罗”号，SS-479；无线电呼号：Ghazi；SJ）是一艘腾奇级柴电潜艇，也是巴基斯坦海军第一艘快速攻击潜艇。巴基斯坦于1963年从美国海军租下该艇。该艇1945年至1963年服役于美国海军；阿尤布政府成功与肯尼迪政府协商采购后，美国依据安全援助计划，以四年租约将其借给巴基斯坦。

en.s: Montreux Casino (Casino Barrière de Montreux) is a casino located in Montreux, Switzerland on the shoreline of Lake Geneva. It has served as the venue for the Montreux Jazz Festival and was rebuilt following a 1971 fire memorialized in the Deep Purple song "Smoke on the Water". It is a property of Groupe Lucien Barrière. The casino housed Mountain Studios which has since become the museum Queen: The Studio Experience.
en.n: On December 4, 1971, Montreux Casino was destroyed by a fire that began during a concert by the Mothers of Invention after a fan, suspected by Swiss police to be Zdeněk Špička, a Czechoslovak refugee living in Épalinges, had shot a flare gun.

zh.s: 蒙特勒赌场（Casino Barrière de Montreux）位于瑞士蒙特勒，坐落在日内瓦湖畔。它曾是蒙特勒爵士音乐节的举办场地，1971年遭遇火灾后重建；深紫乐队的歌曲《水上烟雾》记录了这场火灾。赌场归路西安·巴里埃集团所有。这里曾设有山地录音室，如今已改为“皇后乐队：录音室体验”博物馆。
zh.n: 1971年12月4日，蒙特勒赌场在一场火灾中被毁。火灾发生时，乐队Mothers of Invention正在演出；此前一名观众发射了信号枪。瑞士警方怀疑此人是捷克斯洛伐克难民兹德涅克·什皮奇卡，当时他居住在埃帕兰日。

en.s: The 1972 Toronto municipal election was held December 4, 1972 to elect the governments of Toronto, the five other boroughs, and the government of Metro Toronto as well. The election was overshadowed by the 1972 federal election held October 30 and the American elections held November 7, but it resulted in a dramatic change in the city government. Four new mayors were elected, and 17 of 32 Metro seats were held by newcomers. In the City of Toronto, control of city council was won by the reform faction and reform leader David Crombie was elected mayor.

zh.s: 1972年12月4日，多伦多举行市政选举，选出多伦多市、其他五个自治市镇及大多伦多政府的领导机构。选举受到10月30日举行的加拿大联邦大选和11月7日美国选举的影响，但仍给市政府带来重大变化：4个自治市镇选出了新市长，大多伦多市议会32个席位中有17个由新成员获得。在多伦多市，改革派赢得市议会控制权，改革派领袖戴维·克罗姆比当选市长。

en.s: The insurgency in Aceh, officially designated the Rebellion in Aceh (Indonesian: Pemberontakan di Aceh) by the Indonesian government, was a conflict fought by the Free Aceh Movement (GAM) between 1976 and 2005, with the goal of making the province of Aceh independent from Indonesia. The aftermath of a military offensive in 2003 and the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami brought a peace agreement and an eventual end to the insurgency.

en.s: Malaysian Airline System Flight 653 was a scheduled domestic flight from Penang to Kuala Lumpur in Malaysia, operated by Malaysian Airline System (MAS). On the evening of 4 December 1977, the Boeing 737-200 aircraft flying the service crashed at Tanjung Kupang, Johor, Malaysia, while purportedly being diverted by hijackers to Singapore. It was the first fatal air crash for Malaysia Airlines (as the airline is now known), with all 93 passengers and 7 crew killed.

zh.t: 马来西亚航空系统653号班机空难
zh.s: 马来西亚航空系统653号班机是一趟马来西亚国内定期航班，从槟城飞往吉隆坡。1977年12月4日晚，这架波音737-200客机在柔佛州丹绒古邦坠毁。据称，当时劫机者正试图将飞机改飞新加坡。这是马来西亚航空公司（即现名）首次发生致命空难，机上93名乘客和7名机组人员全部遇难。

en.t: Jean-Bédel Bokassa, president of the Central African Republic, crowns himself Emperor Bokassa I of the Central African Empire
en.s: Jean-Bédel Bokassa ([ʒɑ̃ bedɛl bɔkasa] ; 22 February 1921 – 3 November 1996) was a Central African politician and military officer who served as the second president of the Central African Republic (CAR) and Emperor of the Central African Empire (CAE) as Bokassa I, ruling these two states from 1966 to 1979. Bokassa seized power in the Saint-Sylvestre coup d'état on 1 January 1966.

zh.s: 让-贝德尔·博卡萨（1921年2月22日—1996年11月3日）是中非政治家和军官，曾任中非共和国第二任总统，并以博卡萨一世之名担任中非帝国皇帝；他于1966年至1979年统治这两个国家。博卡萨于1966年1月1日发动圣西尔维斯特政变并夺取政权。

en.t: U.S. Navy aircraft strike Syrian positions in Lebanon
en.s: On December 4, 1983, 28 aircraft from the U.S. carriers John F. Kennedy and Independence attacked Syrian positions in Lebanon after Syrian forces fired on American aircraft the previous day. An A-6 and an A-7 were shot down. The A-6 pilot died, its navigator was captured, and the A-7 pilot was rescued.

zh.t: 美军舰载机空袭黎巴嫩境内的叙利亚阵地
zh.s: 1983年12月4日，美军“约翰·肯尼迪”号和“独立”号航母出动28架飞机，空袭黎巴嫩境内的叙利亚阵地。前一天，叙利亚部队曾向美军飞机开火。空袭中，美军一架A-6攻击机和一架A-7攻击机被击落：A-6飞行员死亡，领航员被俘；A-7飞行员获救。

en.s: The 1984 Mannar massacre was the killing of 200+ minority Sri Lankan Tamils civilians by Sri Lankan Army soldiers in the town of Mannar, north-western Sri Lanka, on December 4, 1984. The attack was triggered when three Army jeeps hit a land mine, killing one soldier. In retaliation, landmarks such as the Central hospital, the post office, a Roman Catholic convent as well as villagers working in rice paddy fields and bus passengers were attacked.

zh.s: 1984年12月4日，斯里兰卡军队士兵在该国西北部曼纳尔镇杀害了200多名泰米尔族平民。此前，3辆军用吉普车压中地雷，造成一名士兵死亡。随后，军队展开报复，袭击了中央医院、邮局、罗马天主教修道院，以及在稻田劳作的村民和乘坐巴士的乘客。

en.t: United States Senate special election in North Dakota, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States Senate special election in North Dakota was held December 4, 1992 to fill the United States Senate seat vacated by the late Quentin Burdick. Burdick's widow, Jocelyn Burdick, was appointed as a temporary replacement until the election was held. Dem-NPLer Kent Conrad, who held North Dakota's other senate seat for one term since 1986, had not run for re-election to his own seat, holding himself to a campaign promise pledging to reduce the federal deficit. U.S. Senator Kent Conrad won the election.

zh.t: 1992年美国北达科他州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1992年12月4日，北达科他州举行美国联邦参议员特别选举，填补奎因廷·伯迪克去世后空出的席位。选举举行前，伯迪克的遗孀乔斯林·伯迪克获任临时参议员。民主党—无党派联盟成员肯特·康拉德自1986年起已担任该州另一个参议员席位一届；他没有竞选连任自己原来的席位，因为他承诺要削减联邦赤字。肯特·康拉德赢得了这次特别选举。

en.s: A by-election was held in the Barbadian constituency of the St. Michael North West on 4 December 1996 after the resignation of Democratic Labour Party member Lawson Weekes who was the representative of the constituency in the House of Assembly of Barbados. It was the last Barbadian by-election to take place in the 20th century.

zh.s: 1996年12月4日，巴巴多斯圣迈克尔西北选区举行补选。此前，民主工党议员劳森·威克斯辞去巴巴多斯众议院该选区代表的职务。这是20世纪巴巴多斯举行的最后一次补选。

en.s: The Battle of Kanakarayankulam was fought on 4 December 1997, during the Sri Lankan civil war between the Sri Lanka Armed Forces and the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE). It is known as the "worst-ever commando debacle" in Sri Lankan military history.

zh.t: 卡纳卡拉扬库拉姆战役（1997年）
zh.s: 1997年12月4日，斯里兰卡武装部队与泰米尔伊拉姆猛虎解放组织（LTTE）在斯里兰卡内战期间爆发卡纳卡拉扬库拉姆战役。该战役被称为斯里兰卡军事史上“最严重的突击队惨败”。

en.s: Unity, also known as Node 1, is the first U.S.-built component of the International Space Station (ISS). This cylindrical module, constructed of aluminium by Boeing for NASA, serves as the critical link between the orbiting laboratory's Russian Orbital Segment and US Orbital Segment. Unity was launched on December 4, 1998, aboard the Space Shuttle Endeavour on STS-88.

zh.s: 团结号（又称Node 1）是国际空间站首个由美国建造的组件。这个圆柱形舱段由波音公司为NASA使用铝材建造，是连接轨道实验室俄罗斯舱段和美国舱段的关键部分。团结号于1998年12月4日搭乘奋进号航天飞机执行STS-88任务升空。

en.s: The Battle of Sayyd Alma Kalay that took place near the Arghandab River in Afghanistan during the United States invasion of Afghanistan. The Taliban were defeated by the United States and its Afghan allies, setting the stage for the Fall of Kandahar.

en.s: K-1 World Grand Prix 2004 Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. It was the twelfth K-1 World Grand Prix final, involving twelve of the world's best K-1 fighters (four being reservists) from eight countries, with all bouts fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs). The tournament qualifiers had almost all qualified via the K-1 World Grand Prix 2004 Final Elimination with the exception of Remy Bonjasky who was the reigning champion. The tournament winner was Remy Bonjasky who won his second consecutive K-1 World Grand Prix title by defeating Musashi in the final by second extra round unanimous decision in a repeat of the previous years final.

zh.s: 2004年K-1世界大奖赛总决赛是由K-1组织主办的踢拳赛事，也是第12届K-1世界大奖赛总决赛。来自8个国家的12名顶尖K-1选手参赛，其中4人为替补；所有比赛均按K-1规则进行，体重级别标为100公斤（156–220磅）。除卫冕冠军雷米·博贾斯基外，其他选手几乎都是通过2004年K-1世界大奖赛最终淘汰赛晋级。博贾斯基在决赛中经过第二个加赛回合，以一致判定击败武藏，连续第二年夺得K-1世界大奖赛冠军。

en.s: A leadership election was held in the Civic Democratic Party (ODS) in the Czech Republic on 4 December 2004. The incumbent leader Mirek Topolánek ran unopposed and his victory was expected. Topolánek received votes from 354 of the 391 party delegates.

zh.s: 2004年12月4日，捷克公民民主党（ODS）举行党魁选举。时任党魁米雷克·托波拉内克在无人竞争的情况下参选，他的胜选早在意料之中。391名党代表中有354人投票支持他。

en.s: General elections were held in Niger in 2004; the first round of the presidential elections was held on 16 November, with a run-off held alongside National Assembly elections on 4 December. The presidential elections were won by Mamadou Tandja of the National Movement for the Society of Development (MNSD). The MNSD also emerged as the largest party in the National Assembly, winning 47 of the 113 seats.

en.s: The 2005 FAI Cup final was the final match of the 2005 FAI Cup. The final took place on 4 December 2005 at Lansdowne Road, Dublin in front of a crowd of 24,521 and a television audience which peaked at 285,000. This was the largest attendance at an FAI Cup Final since 1990.

zh.s: 2005年爱尔兰足协杯决赛是该届赛事的最后一场比赛，于2005年12月4日在都柏林兰斯当路球场举行，现场观众24,521人，电视观众峰值达285,000人。这是自1990年以来爱尔兰足协杯决赛现场观众人数最多的一次。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kazakhstan on 4 December 2005. Incumbent president Nursultan Nazarbayev, in power since 1989, sought and won a 3rd term against four other candidates. Opposition candidates were allowed some access to the mass media, but this was still restricted. According to western election observers, opposition candidates also suffered considerable harassment. The Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE) criticized the elections, calling them unfair, but noted improvements.

zh.s: 2005年12月4日，哈萨克斯坦举行总统选举。自1989年起执政的时任总统努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫竞选第三个任期，并击败其他4名候选人胜出。反对派候选人可以有限度地接触大众媒体，但仍受到限制。西方选举观察员称，反对派候选人还遭到相当程度的骚扰。欧洲安全与合作组织批评选举不公，但也指出情况有所改善。

en.s: The Moscow legislative election of 2005 was held on 4 December of that year to the fourth convocation of the Moscow City Duma. On party lists via proportional representation were elected 18 of the 35 deputies, while 17 deputies were in single-member constituencies. To get into the City Duma via a party list, parties need to overcome the 10% threshold.

zh.s: 2005年莫斯科市杜马选举于当年12月4日举行，选出第四届莫斯科市杜马议员。35名议员中，18名通过比例代表制的政党名单选出，另17名来自单一选区。政党需获得至少10%的选票，才能通过政党名单进入市杜马。

en.s: A leadership spill of the Australian Labor Party (ALP) was held on 4 December 2006. Opposition Leader Kim Beazley was challenged by Shadow Foreign Minister Kevin Rudd, while Deputy Opposition Leader Jenny Macklin was challenged by Shadow Health Minister Julia Gillard in a joint-ticket. Rudd defeated Beazley, after which Macklin resigned, leaving Gillard to become Deputy Leader unopposed.

zh.t: 2006年澳大利亚工党领导权选举
zh.s: 2006年12月4日，澳大利亚工党（ALP）举行党魁改选。反对党领袖金·比兹利受到影子外交部长陆克文挑战；副反对党领袖珍妮·麦克林则与影子卫生部长朱莉娅·吉拉德搭档接受挑战。陆克文击败比兹利后，麦克林辞职，吉拉德在无人竞争的情况下成为副领袖。

en.s: Sin Salida (Spanish for "No Escape") was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on December 4, 2009. The main event of the event was a Lucha de Apuestas, hair vs. hair match between the teams of El Texano Jr. and El Terrible against No Limit (Yujiro and Naito), which was the latest highlight of a "Mexico vs. Japan" storyline that CMLL has presented since the summer of 2009. Also on the show was a match for the CMLL World Tag Team Championship as reigning champions Volador Jr. and La Sombra defends against Los Hijos del Averno (Mephisto and Ephesto).

zh.s: 《无路可逃》（西班牙语意为“无路可逃”）是由墨西哥摔角推广公司世界摔角理事会（CMLL）制作的一场职业摔角大型赛事，于2009年12月4日举行。主赛是一场“赌注赛”，以头发为赌注：埃尔·特哈诺二世和埃尔·特里布尔对阵“无极限”组合（裕次郎和内藤）。这场比赛是CMLL自2009年夏季以来推出的“墨西哥对日本”剧情线中的最新焦点。赛事还包括一场CMLL世界双打冠军赛，卫冕冠军沃拉多尔二世和拉·松布拉迎战“地狱之子”组合（梅菲斯托和埃菲斯托）。

en.s: The Gosport Conservative Party parliamentary primary of 2009 was the 1st open primary election used to select the Conservative Prospective Parliamentary Candidate for the constituency of Gosport. The election was held on Friday 4 December 2009 under the first-past-the-post system. The incumbent MP, Sir Peter Viggers, had announced his intention to decline re-election following the parliamentary expenses scandal, in which he gained huge media attention for attempting to claim £1,645 for a duck house.

zh.s: 2009年戈斯波特保守党议会候选人初选是英国首次采用的开放式初选，用来选出代表戈斯波特选区的保守党议会候选人。选举于2009年12月4日星期五举行，采用简单多数制。时任议员彼得·维格斯爵士此前宣布不再竞选连任；在议会开支丑闻中，他试图报销1,645英镑购买鸭舍一事引发广泛媒体关注。

en.s: Operation Cobra's Anger was a US-led offensive in Helmand province in southern Afghanistan. About 1,000 Marines as well as 150 Afghan troops were involved. The operation began in the early hours of 4 December 2009. The main goal of the operation was to disrupt Taliban supply and communications lines in the strategic Now Zad valley of Helmand province.

zh.s: “眼镜蛇之怒”行动是美国主导的一次攻势，目标是阿富汗南部赫尔曼德省。约1,000名海军陆战队员和150名阿富汗士兵参加。行动于2009年12月4日凌晨开始，主要目标是切断赫尔曼德省具有战略意义的瑙扎德山谷内塔利班的补给线和通信线路。

en.s: MFC 23: Unstoppable was a mixed martial arts event held by the Maximum Fighting Championship (MFC) on December 4, 2009, at the River Cree Resort and Casino in Enoch, Alberta. The main event featured former UFC contender Thales Leites taking on fellow UFC veteran Dean Lister. The co-main event featured Jason MacDonald taking on Solomon Hutcherson. The event aired live on HDNet.

zh.s: MFC 23：势不可挡是Maximum Fighting Championship主办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2009年12月4日在阿尔伯塔省埃诺克的河溪度假村及赌场举行。主赛由前UFC选手塔莱斯·莱特斯对阵同为UFC老将的迪恩·利斯特；联合主赛由杰森·麦克唐纳对阵所罗门·哈切森。赛事通过HDNet直播。

en.t: 49th Anniversary of Lucha Libre in Estado de México
en.s: The 49th Anniversary of Lucha Libre in Estado de México was celebrated by a major professional wrestling show produced and scripted by the Mexican lucha libre promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG; sometimes referred to as Grupo Internacional Revolución in Mexico) and took place on December 4, 2011 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico (Estado de México). The event commemorated the sport of lucha libre becoming allowed in the State of Mexico, with the first lucha libre show held in the state taking place on December 1962. Over the years IWRG has on occasion celebrated the anniversary, although not consistently holding an anniversary show every year.

zh.t: 墨西哥州职业摔角49周年纪念赛
zh.s: 墨西哥州职业摔角49周年纪念活动是一场职业摔角大型赛事，由墨西哥摔角推广公司国际摔角革命集团（IWRG，有时在墨西哥称为Grupo Internacional Revolución）制作并编排，于2011年12月4日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。活动纪念墨西哥州首次允许举行职业摔角赛事；该州首场摔角赛于1962年12月举行。多年来，IWRG偶尔会举办周年纪念赛，但并未每年固定举行。

en.s: A parliamentary election for the 90 deputies to the National Assembly of Slovenia was held on 4 December 2011. This was the first early election in Slovenia's history. 65.60% of voters cast their vote. The election was surprisingly won by the center-left Positive Slovenia party, led by Zoran Janković. However, he failed to be elected as the new Prime Minister in the National Assembly, and the new government was formed by a right-leaning coalition of five parties, led by Janez Janša, the president of the second-placed Slovenian Democratic Party.

zh.s: 2011年12月4日，斯洛文尼亚举行议会选举，选出90名国民议会议员。这是斯洛文尼亚历史上首次提前举行大选，投票率为65.60%。由佐兰·扬科维奇领导的中左翼积极斯洛文尼亚党意外获胜，得票最多；但该党未取得绝对多数。扬科维奇未能在国民议会当选新总理，随后由排名第二的斯洛文尼亚民主党主席亚内兹·扬沙领导的五党右翼联盟组建新政府。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Russia on 4 December 2011. At stake were the 450 seats in the 6th State Duma, the lower house of the Federal Assembly (the legislature). United Russia won the elections with 49.32% of the vote, taking 238 seats or 52.88% of the Duma seats. This result was down from 64.30% of the vote and 70% of the seats in the 2007 elections.

zh.s: 2011年12月4日，俄罗斯举行议会选举，争夺联邦会议下院第六届国家杜马的450个席位。统一俄罗斯党以49.32%的得票率获胜，赢得238席，占杜马席位的52.88%。与2007年选举中64.30%的得票率和70%的席位相比，该党成绩有所下降。

en.s: The Delhi Legislative Assembly election was held on 4 December 2013, with the result announced on 8 December resulting in formation of the Fifth Legislative Assembly of Delhi. The Bharatiya Janata Party won a plurality, closely followed by Aam Aadmi Party, in its first election; this resulted in an hung assembly. After the BJP refused to form a government in the hung assembly, the Aam Aadmi Party's (AAP) Arvind Kejriwal became chief minister with "not conditional" support from the Indian National Congress (INC).

zh.s: 德里立法议会选举于2013年12月4日举行，结果于12月8日公布，并组建德里第五届立法议会。印度人民党得票最多，紧随其后的是首次参选的平民党，结果导致议会没有任何政党取得多数。印度人民党拒绝在这种情况下组建政府后，平民党领袖阿尔温德·凯杰里瓦尔在印度国民大会党“无条件”支持下出任首席部长。

en.s: On 4 December 2014, a group of armed militants of the jihadist organization Caucasus Emirate attacked a traffic police checkpoint outside the city of Grozny, Chechnya, Russia. The militants then entered the city and occupied the "Press House" building in the city center and a nearby school. According to the BBC, the Islamists had claimed to have launched a suicide attack in response to purported attacks by security forces on Muslim women.

zh.s: 2014年12月4日，武装分子在俄罗斯车臣格罗兹尼市郊袭击了一处交警检查站，袭击者来自圣战组织高加索酋长国。随后，武装分子进入市区，占据市中心的“新闻大楼”和附近一所学校。据BBC报道，伊斯兰武装分子声称，此次自杀式袭击是为了回应安全部队据称袭击穆斯林女性。

en.s: On December 4, 2015, a molotov cocktail was thrown into the El Sayad restaurant in Cairo, Egypt. The restaurant fire killed 17 people, and wounded six. The restaurant was also a nightclub and was located in the Agouza district of the city. The restaurant was located in a basement and had no fire exits.

zh.s: 2015年12月4日，有人向埃及开罗的埃尔赛亚德餐厅投掷燃烧瓶，引发火灾，造成17人死亡、6人受伤。该餐厅也作夜总会使用，位于开罗阿古扎区。餐厅设在地下室，没有消防出口。

en.t: German intervention against the Islamic State
en.s: The German intervention against the Islamic State (codenamed Operation Counter Daesh) was authorized on 4 December 2015. The involvement of the country in the Syrian Civil War and the War in Iraq (2013–2017) began with the Bundeswehr mission in Syria and Iraq to combat the terrorist organization Islamic State. The mission was primarily created as a reaction to the November 2015 Paris attacks.

zh.t: 德国对“伊斯兰国”的军事干预
zh.s: 德国于2015年12月4日批准对“伊斯兰国”采取军事行动，行动代号为“反达伊沙行动”。德国参与叙利亚内战和伊拉克战争（2013—2017）的行动，始于联邦国防军在叙利亚和伊拉克执行打击“伊斯兰国”的任务。该任务主要是为回应2015年11月巴黎袭击而设立。

en.s: The Democratic Party leadership election was held on 4 December 2016 for the 30-member 12th Central Committee of the Democratic Party in Hong Kong, including chairperson and two vice-chairperson posts. Incumbent chairwoman Emily Lau, former member of the Legislative Council of Hong Kong who retired in October 2016 announced her retirement from the post and was succeeded by Wu Chi-wai, member of the Legislative Council for Kowloon East, who was elected unopposed, which made it the first uncontested leadership election since 2010.

zh.s: 2016年12月4日，香港民主党举行党魁选举，选出该党第12届中央委员会的30名成员，包括主席和两名副主席。时任主席刘慧卿于2016年10月宣布退休，不再担任党主席。立法会议员、九龙东代表胡志伟接任，他在无人竞争的情况下当选。这是2010年以来该党首次举行没有竞争者的领导层选举。

en.s: Snap presidential elections were held in Uzbekistan on 4 December 2016, following the death of incumbent President Islam Karimov on 2 September. The constitution mandated that the election be held within three months of Karimov's death. Interim President Shavkat Mirziyoyev won the elections with 90% of the vote. The elections were described by the Economist as a sham, and by the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe as lacking "a genuine choice".

zh.s: 2016年12月4日，乌兹别克斯坦举行提前总统选举。此前，时任总统伊斯兰·卡里莫夫于9月2日去世；宪法规定必须在他去世后三个月内举行选举。临时总统沙夫卡特·米尔济约耶夫以90%的得票率胜选。《经济学人》称这次选举是一场骗局，欧洲安全与合作组织则认为选民“没有真正的选择”。

en.s: The 2016 TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brand, SmackDown. It was the eighth annual TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs and took place on December 4, 2016, at the American Airlines Center in Dallas, Texas.

zh.s: 2016年TLC：桌子、梯子与椅子是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）制作的一场付费电视及网络直播赛事，仅安排该公司主力品牌SmackDown的选手参加。这是第八届年度TLC赛事，于2016年12月4日在美国得克萨斯州达拉斯的美国航空中心举行。

en.s: The Muse offensive, also known as the Mong Ko offensive, was a joint military operation by members of the Northern Alliance, consisting of the Arakan Army (AA), the Kachin Independence Army (KIA), the Myanmar National Democratic Alliance Army (MNDAA) and the Ta'ang National Liberation Army (TNLA). The groups targeted towns and border posts along the China–Myanmar border in Muse Township, Myanmar.

en.s: An eruption of Mount Semeru, a volcano in East Java province of the Indonesian island of Java, began on 4 December 2021. en.s: On 4 December 2025, clashes between the Abu Suneima family and the Israeli-backed Popular Forces militia took place in eastern Rafah in the Gaza Strip. The confrontation resulted in the death of Yasser Abu Shabab, the leader of the Popular Forces, after he was critically wounded in a gun battle stemming from a dispute over the detention of a member of the Abu Suneima family. 3 other people were killed or wounded in the fighting, including Ghassan Duhine.
